{{< video https://www.youtube.com/embed/Vrr3lRLjZ1Y >}}

This played on the radio when I was a kid and it was always a good song. But now it hits different. The sound is great and the lyrics are deep. The best part is the [bridge](https://youtu.be/Vrr3lRLjZ1Y?list=RDVrr3lRLjZ1Y&t=142):

> "I never really wanted you to see the screwed up side of me that I keep locked inside of me so deep. It always seems to get to me. I never really wanted you to go. So many things you should have known. I guess for me there's just no hope. I never meant to be so cold"

Actually this [whole album](https://open.spotify.com/album/1namjaJZ23ozXXB7X2d4hy?si=1dsV_6UoQdGenWPLY46nBg) is really good. Some honorable mentions are [_"So Far Away"_](https://open.spotify.com/track/2tHImX6L0zzQKyle2E99O4?si=68cded7b19754618) and [_"Colors"_](https://open.spotify.com/track/1ZtVN326V42hioNyRjU4P2?si=4f5f5404a9fb4695).
